title: Call
description: One handler's call on one input: what it returned, its cost, and whether it matched the outcome.

kind.description: answer, escalate, waiting, dropped or refused

value.description: the answer, as text (JSON for anything structured)

reason.description: why it escalated, waited, dropped or was refused

parent.description: the call that asked for this one, if nested

correct.description: whether the answer matched the outcome (empty until known, or when not scorable)

escalate_to.description: where it escalated to, if it said
